source_text: 近年来,中国新能源汽车产业发展迅速。目前,中国新能源汽车年产量已高达近千万辆，占 全球市场份额超过60%,出口量不断创出新高。中国政府通过加大资金投入和政策引导,鼓励 新能源汽车企业进行技术创新,不断提高产品在市场上的竞争力。中国新能源汽车产业的发展 不仅有力推动了国内经济发展,也为全球新能源利用和环境保护做出了积极贡献。
reference_translation: In recent years, the new energy vehicle industry in China has developed rapidly. Currently, the annual production of new energy vehicles in China has reached nearly ten million, accounting for over 60% of the global market share, and the export volume has continuously hit new highs. The Chinese government encourages new energy vehicle enterprises to carry out technological innovation and continuously improve the competitiveness of their products in the market by increasing capital investment and providing policy guidance. The development of China's new energy vehicle industry has not only strongly promoted the domestic economic development but also made positive contributions to global new energy utilization and environmental protection.
